summary: Public interest litigation seeking enforcement of Section 4 RTI Act obligations; suo motu disclosure mandates including organizational details, decision-making procedures, budget allocations; clarification on scope: proactive transparency for anti-corruption purposes versus exemptions for sensitive information; Task Force guidelines (2013) and O.M. (2019) compliance mechanisms including third-party audits; directions issued for implementation; no merit in challenging statutory framework itself.
final_judgment: Writ petition disposed of with directions to implement Section 4 RTI Act through existing mechanisms including third-party audits and monitoring per 2013 Guidelines and 2019 O.M.; no further order required.
